image_generation_validator.description: Validates successful image generation and proper tool usage

error_handling_validator.description: Validates proper error handling for invalid inputs

prompt_construction_validator.description: Validates that prompts are properly constructed with style prefix and character details

image_agent_specifics: Use the Gemini image adapter (legacy class name ImagenTool)
One image per call; six calls for a complete story
Pass the first successful scene image as reference to later scenes
Only include characters listed in scene.characters
Return success=false on errors; never invent image URLs
GCS objects remain private; signed URLs or inline fallback
trajectory_expectations: Proper prompt construction from input data
performance_considerations: GCS bucket storage preferred over base64 for token efficiency
Graceful fallback to base64 when bucket unavailable
